Stack: Once UI Stack is set up: this project was generated by the Stack scaffolder with its dashboard surface (a product shell with sidebar, header, organisation switcher, user menu and demo data, running in demo mode with no backend), and it uses `@once-ui-system/core`. Read `project/AGENTS.md` first: it maps where everything lives. The Once UI agent documentation installed with it is in the `docs/` folder (start with `docs/AGENTS.md`).

Task: Lumen's team page. At `/`, a members table shows each person's avatar or initials, name, email, role and status, with role and status as badges. A search field and a role filter narrow the table. Each row has an actions menu ("Change role", "Resend invite" for invited people, "Remove"). # Lumen: notes for coding agents

Read this before the tree: it says where everything lives, so you can go straight to the files a task needs.
Built with Next.js App Router and `@once-ui-system/core`; composition in `stack.json`.

## Map

### Shell
- **Brand, theme, fonts:** `src/resources/once-ui.config.js` — `baseURL`, `fonts`, `style` (brand, accent, neutral, border, theme mode), `dataStyle`, `schema` (product name, logo, email), `social`.
- **Language:** `i18n.locales` in `src/resources/once-ui.config.js` (first = default; sets `<html lang>` and how prices are formatted). Server: `getLocale()` from `src/lib/i18n/server.ts`; client: `useLocale()` from `src/components/LocaleProvider.tsx`. A surface's UI text lives in `src/content/<surface>/labels.ts` (one entry per locale), read with `labelsFor()` from `src/lib/i18n`; translate there, not in components.
- **SEO:** `src/resources/seo.js` exports one object per surface (title, description, path, image); pages pass them to `Meta.generate` and `<Schema>`.
- **Root layout and providers:** `src/app/layout.tsx`, `src/components/Providers.tsx`. MDX rendering: `src/components/Mdx.tsx`. Icons: `src/resources/icons.ts`.
- **Content barrel:** `src/content/index.ts` re-exports the copy files under `src/content/`.

### Dashboard & product shell
- **Signed-in shell:** `src/app/(product)/layout.tsx` with `components/Sidebar.tsx` and `components/Header.tsx` (org switcher, user menu). Org pages: `src/app/(product)/app/[org]/` (home, analytics, users, settings). `/app` redirects to the first org, `/app/demo` in demo mode.
- Routes: `/app`, `/app/[org]`, `/app/[org]/analytics`, `/app/[org]/settings`, `/app/[org]/users`, `/profile`

### Supabase auth
- **Auth:** pages in `src/app/(auth)/auth/` (sign in, sign up, forgot password) and `/auth/update-password`. Supabase clients in `src/lib/sb/`; rate limiting and route gating in `src/lib/sb/proxy.ts` and `src/lib/sb/middleware.ts`, run from `src/proxy.ts`. `isSupabaseConfigured()` in `src/lib/sb/config.ts` switches demo mode (no env vars: nothing gated, sample data). Schema: `supabase/init.sql`.
- Routes: `/auth`, `/auth/update-password`

### Organizations & multi-tenancy
- **Organizations:** guards in `src/lib/orgs/server.ts`; every org-scoped query goes through them (RLS is on with no policies). Roles and `DEMO_ORG_SLUG` in `src/lib/orgs/types.ts`; invitations in `src/lib/orgs/invitations.ts` and `src/app/(orgs)/invite/[token]`; API in `src/app/api/orgs/` and `src/app/api/invitations/`. Schema: `supabase/orgs.sql`, run after `init.sql`.
- Routes: `/invite/[token]`

## Rebranding

These files still carry the template's identity (name, URLs, trademarks, demo copy). Replace or delete what the app does not need; keep the auth, org and billing code as it is unless the task says otherwise.

- `src/resources/seo.js` (30)
- `src/app/(product)/app/[org]/components/TableClient.tsx` (5)
- `src/components/Mdx.tsx` (2)
- `src/app/(auth)/auth/components/AuthCard.tsx` (2)
- `src/resources/once-ui.config.js` (1)
- `src/app/(product)/app/[org]/users/components/TableClient.tsx` (1)
- `src/app/(product)/components/Header.tsx` (1)
- `src/components/effects/PrismGlow.tsx` (1)
- `README.md` (1)

Search: `stack\.once-ui\.com|magic-convert|once-ui-system\/stack|Once UI|Lorant|\/trademarks\/|once-ui\.com\/pricing`. Logos and demo images live in `public/`.

## Checking your work

`npm run typecheck`, then `npm run build` (needs no environment variables: the app runs in demo mode), then `npm start` and request the pages.

# @once-ui-system/core — agent harness

This package ships an agent-first codegen harness under `ai/`, next to this file. Use it when **writing Once UI code**, not full MDX documentation pages. Paths below are relative to this file (in an app: `node_modules/@once-ui-system/core/`).

## Starting an app

A new signed-in app (sidebar, top bar, content panel) starts from `ai/starters/app/`: a working Next.js App Router setup with Once UI's CSS, fonts, providers and theme in `src/app/layout.tsx`, the shell mounted once in `src/app/(app)/layout.tsx`, and two pages. Copy it over the create-next-app files, then edit it rather than rewriting it:

```bash
cp -r node_modules/@once-ui-system/core/ai/starters/app/src/. src/ && rm -f src/app/page.module.css src/app/globals.css
```

No `src/` folder? Copy into the project root instead.

The copy takes `src/` only: also set `experimental.optimizePackageImports: ["@once-ui-system/core"]` in `next.config`, as `ai/starters/app/next.config.ts` does, or every route that imports the package root from a server component ships about 110 kB of extra JavaScript.

- `src/resources/app.ts`: product name, user and nav. The sidebar, breadcrumb and ⌘K palette all read it. Each nav href needs a page under `src/app/(app)/`; copy `home/page.tsx`.
- `src/resources/once-ui.config.ts`: brand, accent, neutral and `defaultTheme` (`theme` itself stays `"system"`, or the theme switch stops working).
- `src/components/AppShell.tsx`: the frame. Change it only to change the frame; it already covers the app-shell bundle's quality bar.

Then build each page from the bundle below that fits it.

## Writing a page or feature

Every file you read is sent again on every later turn, so read what you need in one step, then write.

1. Pick the bundle below closest to what you are building and read it, together with any project files you need (in a Next.js app at least `app/layout.tsx`, which mounts the providers), in a single step. Open those project files by path: listing their folder first costs a turn, and every turn re-sends the bundle. A bundle is complete: the rules, every component's props, types, gotchas, the quality bar and a gold example. Then write the code.
2. Need a component the bundle does not list? Every bundle has the components in the `page.md` row; the Adds column names what each one carries on top. Read the `ai/components/<Name>.json` of anything else your page needs in that same step, not after the bundle.
3. Nothing fits? Read `ai/bundles/page.md` (the rules and the common components) with the `ai/components/<Name>.json` slices your page needs, in one step. `ai/catalog.json` names every component with its purpose.

Never open `ai/spec.json`: it is the full machine spec, for tooling.

|---|---|---|

| `ai/bundles/chat.md` | Chat UI: Message list with avatars, typing indicator, composer with send and attach, conversation list | ChatMessageList, ChatMessage, ChatComposer, TypingIndicator, ConversationItem, SplitView, EmojiPickerDropdown, Fade, Kbd, User, Line |

content.content: # List / table page A page of records: title with the primary action, a status filter, a searchable, sortable, paginated Table with status tags and row actions, and an empty state This file is complete for this task: the rules (all of `rules.compact.md`), the props of every component below, their mixins and types, every gotcha for these components, the quality bar and a gold example. Write the page from it; reading the rules, catalog, gotchas, manifest or examples again only adds cost. Open `components/.json` only for a component not listed here, and then every one you need in a single step. ## Rules ### Layout | Write | Never write | |-------|-------------| | `` | `` | | `` | ``, or `` with no direction | | `fill` | `fillWidth fillHeight` | | `fit` | `fitWidth fitHeight` | | `center` | `horizontal="center" vertical="center"` | | `maxWidth="l"` | `fillWidth maxWidth="l"` | | `fillWidth` | `fillWidth minWidth={0}` | | `width="32" height="32"` (32 px, a spacing token); `height={20}` (320 px: past `"160"` there is no token, use rem) | `width={32} height={32}` (a number is rem: 512 px), `height="320"` (not a token) | | `border` | `border="neutral-alpha-weak"` | | `` | a `` and a `` | - `Flex` only when direction changes at breakpoints: `` - Subtree theme: `theme`, `themeBorder`, `themeSolid`, `themeSurface` on Flex/Row/Column/Grid and components built on them (`Background`, `Tag`, effects) — not raw `data-theme`/`data-border`/`data-solid`. `Button`/`IconButton` have no typed prop: keep `data-border="rounded"` - App theme in `once-ui.config` `style`: `defaultTheme: "light"` = starts light, visitor can switch (`theme: "light"` forces it and `setTheme` does nothing). Exact brand colours: `brandScale`/`neutralScale` `{ 100: "#…", …, 1200: "#…" }` (with or without a seed; per theme `{ light: {…}, dark: {…} }`), page/card colour: `pageBackground`/`surfaceBackground` (token or colour, or `{ light, dark }`), not overrides of semantic CSS variables - Page skeleton: `Column as="main" fillWidth horizontal="center"` → content `Column maxWidth="l"` → sections - Section gaps: `"104"` between sections, `"24"`–`"40"` inside. Never `"48"` between major sections. - Responsive: breakpoint props `xl l m s xs` — never media queries for layout ### Surfaces Static panel recipe (pricing tiers, stats, settings sections): ```tsx ``` - Bare `border` (and `borderTop`, `borderBottom`, …) = the default border. Name a colour only to deviate: `border="brand-alpha-medium"`. - `Card` = interactive only (`href` or `onClick`). Static panels = Column + surface recipe. - Colors: `{scheme}-{weight}` or `{scheme}-alpha-{weight}`. Never hex/rgb — inline SVG `fill`/`stroke` included: `currentColor` or `var(--brand-solid-strong)`. - `background` also: `surface | overlay | page | transparent` ### Typography - Hero: `display-strong-l` or `display-strong-xl` - Section titles: `display-strong-xs` or `display-strong-s` — not `heading-*` - Eyebrow: `` - Text on layout: `textVariant` + `onBackground` on Row/Column instead of nesting Text ### Decoration Absolute layers always: `position="absolute" top="0" left="0" fill pointerEvents="none"`, content `zIndex={1}`. - `zIndex` only inside that layer group (or on a sticky header over its pane). Never on a lone element, never a page-wide ladder. - Gradient `width`: quarter-percent (400 = 100%). Glows: 100–200. - Glow colors: `brand-alpha-medium`, not `brand-background-weak` - Ambient layers on full-bleed section wrapper, outside `maxWidth` column - Budget: one ambient layer per section; motion in hero + one CTA max ### Motion - `RevealFx delay` (and `ShineFx`/`CountFx`/`TypeFx speed`, `Animation`/`HoverCard`/`Hover`/`Skeleton` delays) in **milliseconds**: `delay={index * 100}` — `* 0.1` was 1.8.x. `speed` on `MatrixFx`, `WeatherFx`, `ParticleFx` is a multiplier - `RevealFx translateY`: number = rem; prefer `"8"`–`"16"` tokens - Viewport-reveal with `useInViewport` + latch into `RevealFx revealed`; `CountFx` driven by `value`, no trigger prop - Animate all siblings in a set or none — never one lone animated card ### Components | Need | Use | |------|-----| | Image | `Media` | | Link | `SmartLink` / `Button href` | | Status dot | `StatusIndicator` | | Loading | `Spinner` / `Skeleton` | | Scroll fade | `Fade` as edge strip, not wrapper | | Icons | `IconName` (the IconName type below) only | | Logos grid | `LogoCloud` with `columns` set | | Tabs | `Tabs` > `TabList` > `Tab`, `TabPanel` (`orientation="vertical"` for a settings nav) | | Mobile nav, side sheet | `Drawer`, not a hand-made overlay | | Page trail | `Breadcrumbs items={[...]}` | | Keyboard shortcut | `useHotkeys("mod+k", fn)` + `KeyTip keys="mod+k"`; a key cap is `Kbd` | | Screen-reader text, skip link | `VisuallyHidden` (skip link: ``) | | Native attributes | Every component also takes its element's own: `aria-*`, `id`, `role`, `onClick`; `type` on `Button`; `value`, `onChange`, `type` on `Input` | | MDX content | `mdxComponents` / `createMdxComponents` from `/mdx` | ### Imports Most things come from the package root. These do not — each component below says where it comes from when it is not the root: | Import | From | |--------|------| | charts, gauges, chart chrome | `@once-ui-system/core/data` (needs `recharts`) | | `CodeBlock` | `@once-ui-system/core/code` (needs `prismjs`) | | `MediaUpload` | `@once-ui-system/core/media` (needs `compressorjs`) | | `Map`, `MapMarker(s)`, `MapPin`, `MapPopup`, `MapCircle` | `@once-ui-system/core/map` (needs `maplibre-gl`) | | `mdxComponents`, `createMdxComponents`, `Mdx*` elements | `@once-ui-system/core/mdx` (needs `prismjs`) | | `MediaAudioPlayer`, `MediaVideoPlayer` | `@once-ui-system/core/components/` | | `LayoutProvider` in a **Next.js** app; `createOgFetchRoute`, `createOgProxyRoute` | `@once-ui-system/core/next` | | `defineConfig`, `OnceUIConfig` in `once-ui.config` | `@once-ui-system/core/config` (also on the root) | Naming one of these from the root does not resolve — except `defineConfig`, which is on both, and `LayoutProvider`, which resolves and then silently renders links and images as plain `` and `` in a Next.js app. `IconName` is a real union, so an unregistered icon name is a type error, not a blank space — take names (the IconName type below). Brand marks are not in the set: an app registers them by augmenting `IconLibraryOverrides`. ### Types — the common type errors Every type a prop names is defined in the slice's (or bundle's) `types`. - Responsive `xl`/`l`/`m`/`s`/`xs` props exist only on `Flex`, `Row`, `Column` and `Grid`. `Text` and `Heading` take only `s={{ hide: true }}`. To change a `Button`, `Text` or anything else at a breakpoint, wrap it in one of those. - `vertical`/`horizontal` take `start | center | end | between | around | even | stretch` — no `baseline`; for baseline-aligned text write `style={{ alignItems: "baseline" }}`. - Spacing (`gap`, `padding`, …) takes the SpacingToken values below: `"4"`, `"8"`, `"12"`, `"16"`, `"20"`, `"24"`, `"32"`, `"40"`… — there is no `"6"` or `"10"`. - `Row`, `Column` and `Grid` have no `span` or `type`. A clickable row is a `Button` or a native ` setFilter(value as Filter)} buttons={[ { value: "all", label: "All" }, { value: "active", label: "Active" }, { value: "invited", label: "Invited" }, { value: "suspended", label: "Suspended" }, ]} /> [ {member.name} {member.email} , member.role, {statusTag[member.status].label} , member.lastActive, ]), }} actions={[ { icon: "edit", tooltip: "Edit member", onClick: (row) => onEdit?.(visible[row]), }, { icon: "trash", tooltip: "Remove member", variant: "danger", onClick: (row) => onRemove?.(visible[row]), }, ]} emptyState={ No members match this filter. } /> ); } ```
